+"""Test-only POST inventory: public schema plus independent visibility guard.
+
+Newer FastAPI supplies the non-underscore routing iterator used by its own
+OpenAPI generator. Older versions expose flat Starlette routes. Never inspect
+private router classes, include contexts, or underscore-prefixed attributes.
+An unsupported opaque surface fails closed instead of being silently omitted.
+"""
+from collections import Counter
+
+from fastapi import routing
+from starlette.routing import Mount, Route, WebSocketRoute
+from starlette.staticfiles import StaticFiles
+
+
+def effective_post_paths(application):
+    iterator = getattr(routing, "iter_route_contexts", None)
+    surfaces = iterator(application.routes) if callable(iterator) else application.routes
+    paths = []
+    for surface in surfaces:
+        route = surface.route if callable(iterator) else surface
+        if isinstance(route, Mount):
+            # StaticFiles accepts GET/HEAD only. Arbitrary ASGI mounts could
+            # hide POST endpoints and must receive explicit future coverage.
+            assert type(route.app) is StaticFiles, "unverified mounted HTTP surface"
+            continue
+        if isinstance(route, WebSocketRoute):
+            continue
+        assert isinstance(route, Route), "unverified opaque HTTP route surface"
+        methods = surface.methods
+        assert methods is not None, "HTTP route has no inspectable methods"
+        if "POST" in methods:
+            path = surface.path_format
+            assert isinstance(path, str) and path.startswith("/"), "POST path unavailable"
+            paths.append(path)
+    duplicates = sorted(path for path, count in Counter(paths).items() if count != 1)
+    assert not duplicates, f"duplicate effective POST operations: {duplicates}"
+    return set(paths)
+
+
+def schema_post_paths_with_visibility_guard(application):
+    # Do not let a stale cached schema conceal a route added after generation.
+    cached = application.openapi_schema
+    try:
+        application.openapi_schema = None
+        paths = {
+            path for path, operations in application.openapi()["paths"].items()
+            if "post" in operations
+        }
+    finally:
+        application.openapi_schema = cached
+    effective = effective_post_paths(application)
+    assert effective == paths, (
+        f"POST schema visibility mismatch: hidden={sorted(effective - paths)}, "
+        f"schema_only={sorted(paths - effective)}"
+    )
+    return paths

diff --git a/tests/unit/test_post_route_surface_compatibility.py b/tests/unit/test_post_route_surface_compatibility.py
new file mode 100644
index 00000000..5bd0aead
--- /dev/null
+++ b/tests/unit/test_post_route_surface_compatibility.py
@@ -0,0 +1,78 @@
+"""Negative controls outside frozen release-blocking membership."""
+import asyncio
+
+from fastapi import APIRouter, FastAPI
+import httpx
+import pytest
+from starlette.staticfiles import StaticFiles
+
+from tests.post_route_surface import schema_post_paths_with_visibility_guard
+
+
+async def endpoint():
+    return {}
+
+
+def test_nested_included_router_and_prefixes_are_discovered():
+    app = FastAPI()
+    leaf = APIRouter(prefix="/leaf")
+    leaf.add_api_route("/post", endpoint, methods=["POST"])
+    middle = APIRouter(prefix="/middle")
+    middle.include_router(leaf, prefix="/nested")
+    app.include_router(middle, prefix="/api")
+    assert schema_post_paths_with_visibility_guard(app) == {"/api/middle/nested/leaf/post"}
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("hiding", ["direct", "route", "router", "include", "nested-include"])
+def test_hidden_post_is_rejected(hiding):
+    app = FastAPI()
+    if hiding == "direct":
+        app.add_api_route("/hidden", endpoint, methods=["POST"], include_in_schema=False)
+    else:
+        router = APIRouter(include_in_schema=hiding != "router")
+        router.add_api_route("/hidden", endpoint, methods=["POST"], include_in_schema=hiding != "route")
+        if hiding == "nested-include":
+            middle = APIRouter()
+            middle.include_router(router, prefix="/nested", include_in_schema=False)
+            router = middle
+        app.include_router(router, prefix="/api", include_in_schema=hiding != "include")
+    with pytest.raises(AssertionError, match="POST schema visibility mismatch"):
+        schema_post_paths_with_visibility_guard(app)
+
+
+def test_cached_schema_does_not_hide_later_hidden_registration():
+    app = FastAPI()
+    original = app.openapi()
+    app.add_api_route("/hidden", endpoint, methods=["POST"], include_in_schema=False)
+    with pytest.raises(AssertionError, match="POST schema visibility mismatch"):
+        schema_post_paths_with_visibility_guard(app)
+    assert app.openapi_schema is original
+
+
+def test_duplicate_post_path_is_not_collapsed_to_one_schema_operation():
+    app = FastAPI()
+    app.add_api_route("/same", endpoint, methods=["POST"])
+    router = APIRouter()
+    router.add_api_route("/same", endpoint, methods=["POST"])
+    app.include_router(router)
+    with pytest.raises(AssertionError, match="duplicate effective POST"):
+        schema_post_paths_with_visibility_guard(app)
+
+
+def test_unknown_mounted_asgi_surface_fails_closed():
+    app = FastAPI()
+    child = FastAPI()
+    child.add_api_route("/hidden", endpoint, methods=["POST"])
+    app.mount("/child", child)
+    with pytest.raises(AssertionError, match="unverified mounted HTTP surface"):
+        schema_post_paths_with_visibility_guard(app)
+
+
+def test_static_mount_exception_cannot_accept_post(tmp_path):
+    app = FastAPI()
+    app.mount("/static", StaticFiles(directory=tmp_path))
+    assert schema_post_paths_with_visibility_guard(app) == set()
+    async def post():
+        async with httpx.AsyncClient(transport=httpx.ASGITransport(app=app), base_url="http://127.0.0.1") as client:
+            return await client.post("/static/anything")
+    assert asyncio.run(post()).status_code == 405
